audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Graves, Graves, Skill, Garen, Skill, Skill, Graves while every why on the page says Garen owns Levels 1 through 4-5. The mirror audit (garen vs graves) already flipped its chart to Garen from Level 1 through First item with Graves at 2+ items.
audit.why: Own prose, packet chart and mirror all disagreed with the sides. The mirror is already on disk, so this side must restate the same result inverted.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Graves, Garen rows rated 4/10 and the 2+ row left at 6/10, with all six phase whys restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First item were sold as even windows for Graves; they are not. Demacian Justice is 120/100/80s missing-HP true damage and Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s of shield, tenacity and lasting damage reduction on top of Perseverance regen.
audit.why: Graves' spike is two items, not one — his first item cannot out-trade a Q-W rotation that resets between trades.
audit.corrected: whys[4]/[5], phases[4]/[5] rewritten to Garen with the real timers; the 2+ item spike kept as the genuine Graves takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen was called a blind in six places (whys[4], spikes[1], early, mid, late, wants.you[1], report[10]). Riot's text is a sight-range reduction plus impact magic damage and a brief slow. Worse, Decisive Strike explicitly breaks free of all slows, so even the slow does not hold him.
audit.why: The whole 'blind his Q-empowered auto' plan does not exist — his empowered auto lands through the cloud and his Q cleanses the only real CC the W applies.
audit.corrected: All six restated as a sight cut, with the new and correct interaction written in: Decisive Strike breaks the Smoke Screen slow, and Courage's tenacity shortens what CC does land. Q's silence cancelling your End of the Line cast retained — that part was right.
sources: enemyKit Q text ('breaking free of all slows')

edits.before: Garen owns the first three levels and you have to respect it. At Level 1 you have one ability and no E, so his Q silences you out of your End of the Line cast and lands an empowered auto before your 2-round magazine can answer point-blank. Do not throw a Q he can silence you out of — last-hit at range and wait for your kit to come online. Once you hit Level 3 with Q, W and an E charge you stop conceding free trades: bait or blind his Q with Smoke Screen, dash in with Quickdraw for the 4-shell spread, then E back out as he Q-spins to disengage.
edits.after: Garen owns the first three levels and you have to respect it. At Level 1 you have one ability and no E, so his Q silences you out of your End of the Line cast and lands an empowered auto before your 2-round magazine can answer point-blank. Do not throw a Q he can silence you out of — last-hit at range and wait for your kit to come online. Once you hit Level 3 with Q, W and an E charge you stop conceding free trades: bait the Q on the 8s timer, fog him with Smoke Screen, dash in with Quickdraw for the 4-shell spread, then E out as he spins.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still lean Garen because his Q-W trade pattern beats you while your True Grit stacks and E charges are only half-built — he silences, lands the empowered auto, then W's damage reduction and tenacity plus passive regen reset him before you punish. The lane levels out at 6: his Demacian Justice is missing-HP-scaling true damage, not a flat execute, so it hits hardest when you are low — never sit low in his face, and bait it before your all-in. Drop Smoke Screen on him to blind the Q-empowered auto, dash in with Quickdraw, Q-detonate the cone, and reload-trade — this is where you claw the lane back to even.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still lean Garen because his Q-W trade pattern beats you while your True Grit stacks and E charges are only half-built — he silences, lands the empowered auto, then W's damage reduction and tenacity plus passive regen reset him before you punish. Six stays his: Demacian Justice is missing-HP-scaling true damage, not a flat execute, so it hits hardest when you are low — never sit low in his face, and bait it before any all-in. Smoke Screen cuts his sight only, and Decisive Strike breaks its slow, so fight in the fog for the misses, not for a hold.

edits.before: This is your window — you take over at two items. Your True Grit armor/MR stacks and double E charges out-stat his short Q-spin, so his trade-and-disengage stops trading even; you out-DPS the Q-W rotation, and your Collateral Damage nuke plus a Smoke Screen blind on his empowered auto runs an escape-light Garen down. He has no gap-closer and his only out is the Q-spin disengage, so corner him off that timer and the duel is yours. Just close before a fed Garen with armor-pen items turns the silence into a free pick on you.
edits.after: This is your window — you take over at two items. Your True Grit armor/MR stacks and double E charges out-stat his short Q-spin, so his trade-and-disengage stops trading even; you out-DPS the Q-W rotation, and your Collateral Damage nuke plus Smoke Screen fogging his step-back runs an escape-light Garen down. He has no gap-closer and his only out is Decisive Strike's 8s speed burst, so corner him off that timer and the duel is yours. Just close before a fed Garen with armor-pen items turns the silence into a free pick on you.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Two real errors fixed. (1) Smoke Screen called a blind in six places — it is a sight cut plus brief slow, and Decisive Strike explicitly breaks all slows, so the 'blind his empowered auto' plan never existed. (2) Level chart contradicted its own whys, the packet defect line and the already-written mirror; flipped as one group to Garen through First item, Graves at 2+ items, matching garen__graves. Both packet suspectNames (Demacian Justice) are false positives.
